title: Workflows
subtitle: Create reusable automations for requests, work orders, telemetry, and reminders, then keep an audit trail of each run.

triggerOption.sor_submitted: Service from Schedule of Rate (SOR) Submitted

triggerHint.service_request: Fires when a request is created or completed.
triggerHint.workorder_created: Fires when a work order is created — assign it or notify the team.
triggerHint.asset_field: Scheduled check against an asset date field.
triggerHint.chat_with_staff: Fires when a requestor opens a conversation.
triggerHint.low_sentiment: Fires when AI marks an inbound message as low sentiment.
triggerHint.expenditure_budget_exceeded: Fires when spend exceeds a budget.
triggerHint.parts_quantity: Fires when a part stock drops.
triggerHint.desk_booking: Fires when a desk is booked.
triggerHint.facilities_booking: Fires when a facility is booked.
triggerHint.sensor_integration: Fires on each sensor reading — use a cooldown for chatty sensors.
triggerHint.sor_submitted: Fires when a quote / procurement is raised against the rate schedule.
triggerHint.expenditure_approval: Fires when an approval is requested.

autoAssign.title: Auto-assign work orders
autoAssign.description: Assign new work orders to a responder (optionally filtered by priority). Pick the responder after installing.

usefulLife.title: Email based on asset useful life
usefulLife.description: Email when an asset passes a set number of days since its purchase date.

warranty.title: Email when asset warranty expiry is near
warranty.description: Email when an asset is within a set number of days of its warranty expiry.

pendingReminder.title: Email reminder if request has been pending
pendingReminder.description: Email a reminder when a request has been pending for too long.

chatWithStaff.title: Email when requestor asks to "Chat with Staff"
chatWithStaff.description: Email staff when a requestor asks to chat with a person.
chatWithStaff.message: Requestor wants to chat with staff

budgetExceeded.title: Email when expenditure budget is exceeded
budgetExceeded.description: Email when spend exceeds the configured budget for a cost centre.

lowSentiment.title: Email if requestor sentiment is low
lowSentiment.description: Email for service recovery when AI detects low requestor sentiment.

partsLow.title: Email when parts quantity falls below amount
partsLow.description: Email when a part drops below its reorder threshold.

deskBooking.title: Alert when desk booking is made
deskBooking.description: Alert an account when a desk is booked in a zone.

sensorTicket.title: Create ticket when a sensor is triggered
sensorTicket.description: Create a request when a sensor reading crosses its trigger condition.

meterTicket.title: Create ticket when meter reading exceeds threshold
meterTicket.description: Create a request when a meter reading exceeds a threshold.

meterEmail.title: Email when meter reading exceeds threshold
meterEmail.description: Email when a meter reading exceeds a threshold.

survey.title: Survey after request completion
survey.description: Send a survey to the requestor when a request is completed.

sorExpenditure.title: Expenditure request from SOR response
sorExpenditure.description: Create an expenditure request when a Schedule of Rates response is submitted.

approvalEmail.title: Expenditure approval email
approvalEmail.description: Send an approval email when an expenditure needs sign-off.

confirm.discardOpen: Discard your unsaved changes and open this workflow?
confirm.discard: Discard your unsaved changes to this workflow?
